messages:
jamie: FYI customer (Oriole Tech) has put billing on hold — procurement insists on an "official requisition" number and very specific cost-center formatting before we can send an invoice. They gave an example that failed our AR system. Can finance advise next steps?

maria: thanks for flagging. do we have the exact format they expect? example please.

jamie: here's what they pasted: `REQ-2026-ACCT/42-ENG` and they also said VAT id + billing address must be on invoice. They said 'no invoice without PO' and procurement won't accept our pro-forma.

tony: tagging finance: @bella — is that PO/requisition format something we can accept or map automatically?

bella: hey — we can accept a requisition number but the formatting needs to match our AR import regex. right now our importer expects: `^[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}-[A-Z]{2}-\d{3}$` (e.g., ORD-2026-US-042). the customer's `REQ-2026-ACCT/42-ENG` has a slash and extra segment. we can add a normalization step but need approval for manual mapping and will delay processing ~1 business day.

jamie: the customer also asked for "cost center = ENG/42" to appear in the invoice memo. is that ok?

bella: we can include cost center in the invoice memo field. please confirm exact value they want printed.

jamie: they want `ENG/42` in the memo and `REQ-2026-ACCT/42-ENG` as requisition number.

maria: two blockers: 1) importer regex mismatch, 2) VAT id + billing address need to be on the invoice PDF. do we have their VAT id on file?

tony: procurement provided VAT: GB999888777. billing addr: "Oriole Tech Ltd, 12 Dockside, Liverpool, L1 8AB, UK".

bella: VAT id present. regarding importer: i can do temporary mapping if we get written approval from the customer to alter the requisition format to match our ORD-YYYY-CC-### pattern. otherwise accounting policy requires them to upload the invoice to their AP system themselves.

jamie: customer already said they can't change format on their side. they expect vendor to conform. asked for a PDF example of the invoice layout so they can pre-approve.

maria: suggested path: 1) produce a one-off invoice using their exact requisition string (manual processing), include cost center in memo, and embed VAT + full billing address; 2) escalate to AR to add a normalization rule for future invoices. that buys us time.

bella: i can do manual processing for this invoice. please attach the approved line items and amount. also need a signed PO or email from procurement confirming the requisition string and authorization to bill.

jamie: attaching line items now (see snippet). amount: £9,600. items: "Platform usage Mar 2026" qty 1 net £8,000 VAT £1,600.

arthur-bot: deploy-notice: created ticket AR-4821 (manual invoice processing) assigned to bella.

bella: got it. will draft the invoice PDF with their exact requisition string and cost center. i will annotate the invoice metadata so our importer doesn't drop it later. manual processing ETA: end of day tomorrow UK time.

tony: legal asks we capture the customer's approval note. jamie — can you request a confirmation email from procurement saying 'Oriole Tech confirms requisition REQ-2026-ACCT/42-ENG and authorizes Redwood to invoice for £9,600'?

jamie: on it. pinged their procurement contact.

maria: long-term: we should add a normalization hook in AR import to accept common variants (REQ/REQ-, slashes). i'll open a low-priority eng ticket.

bella: note for accounting: when we do manual invoice, use GL code 4002 (hosted services) and mark external reference = REQ-2026-ACCT/42-ENG. include cost center ENG/42 in memo.

jamie: update — procurement replied and pasted this message: "Confirmed. Oriole Tech authorizes Redwood to invoice for £9,600 against requisition REQ-2026-ACCT/42-ENG. Please include VAT: GB999888777 and cost center ENG/42 on invoice."

bella: perfect — I have written approval. processing now. will confirm when invoice is posted and emailed.

jamie: thanks team. can we also cc the customer's AP email on the invoice? procurement asked for `ap-invoices@orioletech.com`.

bella: yes will cc. final ETA: invoice posted + emailed by 2026-03-18 17:00 BST.

maria: created follow-up ticket ENG-1209 for AR importer normalization and linked to AR-4821.

jamie: closing loop with customer now. will update thread when payment is received. :thumbsup:
